actions.title: Publish a conforming MCP server card at `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
actions.why: 11 live MCP servers exposing 188 tools score zero on every scanner because the existing manifest has no `serverInfo.name`. Biggest gap between what is built and what is credited.

actions.title: Fix the Twitter community/social endpoint contract
actions.why: Six commands return `400: request does not match the endpoint contract` for every documented invocation and every parameter spelling. An agent concluded it is a server-side bug.

actions.title: Return a non-zero exit code when a CLI call fails
actions.why: The CLI exits 0 after failed API calls, so scripts and agents cannot detect failure. Seen in 15 of 50 sampled failing runs.

actions.title: Redirect 9 broken doc URLs to their existing equivalents
actions.why: Agents requested these mid-task and got a 404. Each has a live target page — this is a redirect map, not new content.

actions.title: Write doc pages for shipped endpoints that have none (10 URLs)
actions.why: `/v1/rerank`, `/v1/images/edits` and `/apis/v1/firecrawl/search` are live and evaluated, but an agent following the OpenAPI spec to the matching doc URL finds nothing.

actions.title: Serve OIDC discovery from the apex domain
actions.why: `/.well-known/openid-configuration` exists only on `login.aisa.one`. Scanners and agents probe the apex, so it reads as absent.

actions.title: Add the missing `supportedInterfaces` field to the A2A agent card
actions.why: The card is already served; one required field makes it valid.

actions.title: Surface the CLI and MCP entry points on the site
actions.why: `@aisa-one/cli` is published and maintained but nothing links to it, so three separate checks score it zero. The MCP endpoints are equally unadvertised outside the manifest — link both from the homepage and docs nav.

actions.title: Install `@lightsage/agent-tracker` middleware
actions.why: Agent Analytics has received no events, so there is no data on which pages agents actually read.

actions.title: Provision a capped evaluation wallet
actions.why: A dedicated, spend-capped credential for Lightsage's eval sandbox means a future retest can never again confuse a payment failure with a product failure — which is exactly what happened here twice. Keeps the eval environment isolated from production spend.

actions.title: Verify each fix against the scanners that flagged it
actions.why: Re-run Ora, Cloudflare and the doc link check after shipping. Ora exposes `run_checks` for re-verifying individual checks, and `npm run fetch` in this repo re-requests every flagged doc URL, so the fix list shrinks on its own as items land.

actions.title: Add coding agents to Lightsage visibility tracking
actions.why: 3 of 19 platforms are tracked and none are coding agents. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Copilot recommendations are entirely unmeasured — a settings change, not engineering work.

actions.title: Serve markdown to agents (`Accept: text/markdown` or `/index.md`)
actions.why: Agents arriving from search get HTML only. `Guessed Without Docs` is now the dominant pattern at 65% of runs — agents skip the docs entirely, which cheap machine-readable entry points directly address.

actions.title: Advertise `llms.txt`, sitemap and service-doc via RFC 8288 `Link` headers
actions.why: Lets agents find key resources without parsing HTML.

actions.title: Return a markdown body on 404s listing where to go next
actions.why: A dead-end 404 gives an agent no way to recover, so it falls back to guessing.

actions.title: Make the docs worth opening
actions.why: 65% of runs are `Guessed Without Docs` — agents reach for the API without consulting documentation at all. That is survivable on REST, where the spec carries them, but it is why CLI runs fail: there is no spec to guess from.

actions.title: Fix the remaining 3 medium CLI defects
actions.why: Documented options are not implemented; `aisa twitter space` returns 404; `aisa skills` subcommands fail or no-op.

actions.title: Confirm `GET /v1/errors` is real and documented
actions.why: Scored 0.43 — the agent could not confirm the endpoint exists, and `/docs/api-reference/errors` was separately flagged.

actions.title: Complete the JSON-LD Organization schema
actions.why: Ora scores JSON-LD 2/4 — the Organization type is present but missing `name` and `description`, and Organization completeness is 1/2 for missing `contactPoint` and `address`. Note FAQPage is already present; the gap is the Organization block, plus `Service` or `AggregateRating` for breadth.

actions.title: Publish `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` (ARD) and Content Signals in robots.txt
actions.why: Both are required-tier checks on Ora and Cloudflare that currently score zero.

actions.title: Work the Lightsage GEO task list (Reddit, arXiv, comparison pages)
actions.why: Seven ranked tasks aimed at citation share, detailed later in this report. Slower payback than the items above.
